Sidebar.blurb: Resume is an AI. It answers from Oleksii's résumé and the notes he's added around it — and says so when something isn't there.
Sidebar.disclaimer: One conversation per tab, kept in this tab and gone when you close it. Nothing is stored on the server.

Starters.chaos: How does he handle a project in chaos?
Starters.craft: What does good code mean to him?
Starters.learning: How does he learn a new technology?

EmptyState.title: What can Oleksii do — and what can't he?
EmptyState.subtitle: One question at a time. The assistant retrieves from his CV before it answers, and shows you which parts it used.

Composer.placeholder: Ask about his skills, gaps, or projects…

Chat.noAnswer: No answer came back. Try rephrasing, or pick another model.
Chat.connectionLost: The answer didn't finish — check your connection and try again.
Chat.stopped: Stopped before any answer came back.

Status.notIngested: The knowledge base hasn't been ingested yet — answers will be limited.
Status.unreachable: The backend can't reach its knowledge base right now.
